ios.desc:
“[while taking a written test] Can we finish this orally, my hand is starting to hurt?” That’s what she said!

Ever had a a friend who said something so outrageously funny you wish you’d remember it forever? Quoth lets you immortalize those epic (or embarrassing) moments, by capturing quotes into private collections shared among you and your closest friends.

Get notified as soon as somebody makes a fool of themselves, or browse the timeline to relive those moments over and over again! If you’re not *too* embarrassed, you can also share them with your social networks (Facebook & Twitter), or directly via email or text messaging.
